text.card: A red giant 1,101 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.88 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,733 K at its surface.
